topic: Décrire les Qualités Admirables (Describing Admirable Qualities)

subUnits.title: 4.1 Vocabulaire des Qualités Admirables et les Verbes Aimer/Adorer
notes: Vocabulaire des Qualités Admirables et les Verbes Aimer/Adorer
By the end of this lesson, you will be able to: describe admirable personal qualities, and use the verbs aimer and adorer.
- NEW: chaleureux(se) (warm/warm-hearted — follows -x→-se pattern), formidable (fantastic — UNCHANGING), adorable (adorable — UNCHANGING), magnifique (magnificent — UNCHANGING)
- ADORER follows the EXACT same regular '-ER' pattern as aimer: j'adore, tu adores, il/elle adore, nous adorons, vous adorez, ils/elles adorent
- ADORER expresses STRONGER feeling than AIMER: J'aime mon ami(e) = I like my friend (warm); J'adore mon ami(e) = I adore my friend (deeper affection).
adorer: j'adore | tu adores | il/elle adore | nous adorons | vous adorez | ils/elles adorent
Unchanging adjectives (already end in -e): formidable | adorable | magnifique | fantastique | sympathique

'Aimer' and 'adorer' are like two different VOLUMES on the same emotional dial: 'aimer' is a warm, genuine, comfortable volume — 'adorer' turns the SAME dial up further, to an even more enthusiastic, heartfelt volume.
- Trying to invent a new conjugation for 'adorer' instead of confidently applying the already-known aimer/détester pattern.
- Forgetting that 'formidable,' 'adorable,' and 'magnifique' already end in '-e' and stay UNCHANGED in the feminine.

quiz.explanation: 'Chaleureux(se)' means warm or warm-hearted — the feminine form is 'chaleureuse' (follows -x→-se pattern).
'Formidable' means fantastic or tremendous — and it is UNCHANGING in the feminine.
'Adorable' means adorable — it is also UNCHANGING in the feminine (already ends in -e).
'Magnifique' means magnificent — another adjective that stays unchanged in the feminine.

quiz.q: What is the feminine form of 'chaleureux'?
What is the correct conjugation of 'adorer' for 'je' (I)?
quiz.explanation: 'J'adore' — regular -ER verb, same as j'aime. Note: j' replaces je before a vowel.

quiz.q: What is the correct conjugation of 'adorer' for 'nous' (we)?
quiz.explanation: 'Nous adorons' — regular -ER pattern, -ons ending for nous.

quiz.q: What is the general difference in meaning between 'aimer' and 'adorer'?
opts: They mean exactly the same, with no difference
Adorer is only used for objects, never people
Adorer expresses a stronger, deeper affection than aimer
quiz.explanation: 'Adorer' expresses deeper, more enthusiastic affection than 'aimer,' which conveys warm but less intense liking.

quiz.q: Aimer and adorer are compared to ___ in this week's analogy.
opts: two different volumes on the same emotional dial
volumes with no connection to feeling
quiz.explanation: Both express positive feeling toward someone, but 'adorer' turns the emotional intensity up further — like different volumes on the same dial.

quiz.q: Does 'formidable' change in the feminine form?
quiz.explanation: 'Formidable' already ends in '-e' and remains unchanged in the feminine — same form for both genders.
